column1: # End-to-end instruction paths — the named read paths measure-instruction-load.sh
# reports in addition to the per-flow entry bundle.
# A path is an ordered list of PHASES. Each phase names the trigger that makes
# the agent load the files in it. Bytes are counted ONCE per unique file per
# path; a file that is read at more than one moment is disclosed separately in
# the "Repeated reads" section rather than double-counted.
#   relpath is relative to skills/deepworkplan/ (the installed pack root).
# Rules this file must obey (enforced by tests/context-accounting.bats):
#   - every relpath exists in the pack;
#   - every relpath is DECLARED in the entry flow's "## Shared resources"
#     section, so a path can never drift from the read contract it models;
#   - every path's entry phase is exactly the flow's compulsory read set.
# Exclusions (deliberate, disclosed in the script output): repository files the
# agent also reads (AGENTS.md, docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md, the plan folder, source
# under review), tool output, generated plan files, re-reads after a context
# compaction, and the agent's own output. This measures the SKILL's instruction
